messages.subject: [FLR-list] testing  source("http://flr-project.org/R/instFLR.R")
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

after a lot of time away from FLR I reinstalled all the FLR libraries 
(just for fun :) in my Ubuntu 14.04.

I've got this warning messages:
1: packages ?biodyn (>= 0.0.1)?, ?reshape (>= 0.8.4)?, ?FLash (>= 
2.5.0)?, ?FLAssess (>= 2.5)? are not available (for R version 3.1.3)

Any suggestions?

Saludos.

Santi

messages.body_plain:
Ola,

For fun and profit, I hope.

I have just run

source("http://flr-project.org/R/instFLR.R")

on Ubuntu 14.04, R 3.1.3 and it worked

reshape needs to come from CRAN. Can you try

install.packages('reshape')



Iago
